notes: Both variants share one feature extraction and one seed, so any difference between them is the targets and not the audio or the order.
Metrics are on the training subset, which is memorisation, not generalisation. No WER is claimed as a generalisation result.
dev and test were never opened by this script.

Rows violating frames >= labels are excluded per variant and listed by utterance id. dataset_v001 is not modified and no manifest is rewritten; the permanent disposition of those rows is still an open decision.
